title: RoleOutfit
description: The canonical character-identity record used to lock appearance across the whole channel (TECHNICAL-SPEC-EN.md section 9).

role_outfit_id.description: e.g. 'narrator-default'. A channel normally has one canonical id used everywhere.

version.description: Bumped whenever the canonical appearance changes. Changing appearance must go through a new version, not an ad hoc per-video prompt edit.

canonical_description.description: Full description of proportions, head shape, palette, default outfit.

reference_image_paths.description: Image(s) passed to generate_with_reference() for every scene using this role-outfit.

character_anchor_text.description: The exact CHARACTER_ANCHOR string appended to scene prompts, matching this record's canonical_description.

context.description: When this variant applies, e.g. 'rain scene', 'formal setting'.

outfit_variants.description: Optional context-specific outfit variants layered on top of the canonical description, never replacing its core proportions/palette.
